cancel().notice: Anyone may call, from `expiry` on, if settlement did not happen. Each funded leg goes back to its owner and an unfunded leg is skipped. May be called again if more is sent later (the bond refund certificate is single use, so a bond sent after the first refund stays until the controller moves it).

setCertificates(bytes,bytes).notice: The custodian signs both certificates for this escrow's address, so the address must exist before the certificates do: they are attached right after creation, by the factory, in the same transaction. The certificate expiry is read from its first 32 bytes (the validator's format: expiry | r | s | v, 97 bytes).

settle().notice: Anyone may call, strictly before `expiry`, once both legs are fully funded.
